fields.Name: Skip ICF - Region Engagement Drill-Down
fields.Description: Region-level engagement (members, conference attendance, average tenure) -> top 5 members -> member activity. Ported from "Chapter Engagement with Drill-Down" (regions replace chapters).

InputDefinition.userMessage: Create a regional engagement report showing each region's member count, conference attendance and average member tenure in years, in a chart. Let me click a region to see its top 5 most active members. Then from that list, let me click a member to see their detailed activity history. [NO CHAT]

judgeValidationCriteria: Response includes a chart of NA, EU and RoW with member count, conference attendance and average tenure
Tenure is computed from Member Profiles JoinDate
Clicking a region shows its top 5 members by activity with their activity counts
Clicking a member shows their detailed activity (conferences, courses, committees, certifications or orders)
Rows in the member table can open the underlying person or member profile record
